notes: Partition verified: 18 source and 25 target ids each placed exactly once.

The verse opens mid-sentence: כֹּל takes the relative *that* under rule 46, its antecedent *every one* falling in v18. The competing reading — rule 46's exclusion for a written antecedent plus rule 55, which would make *that* added and leave כֹּל unrepresented — is named in the unit note and remains defensible; I left the accepted reading because כֹּל is itself the substantive the ASV completes with *every one that*.
The italic *he be cleansed* is added: the Hebrew clause writes no verb at all (rule 20).
